claim: Open-source email marketing manager with analytics, segmentation, personalisation, bounce processing and plugins
Features: CSV and Excel import, scheduling, domain throttling, Amazon SES support, RSS feeds, send a webpage
Requires MySQL or MariaDB, Apache and PHP 8.1 or later with listed extensions
Installation steps: download, unzip, upload, create database, edit config.php
A Docker image phplist/phplist is published on Docker Hub
Licensed under AGPLv3; hosted account available at phplist.com with data migration
Upgrade procedure is manual: backup database, copy files, click the upgrade link
Dressprow theme is not currently maintained
